title: Per-tenant on‑prem relay + tenant-aware dashboards for Dedicated/VPC collectors
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Implement a tenant-scoped relay for on-prem/VPC collectors that enforces isolation, backpressure, and per-tenant sampling controls, and surface tenant-centric latency/error dashboards in Console. Motivation: multiple Dedicated customers have reported noisy cross-tenant spikes and unclear root-cause paths when edge collectors burst. We need an operationally safe relay layer that (a) authenticates and mTLSs collector connections, (b) provides per-tenant buffering and replay on intermittent network loss, (c) exposes tracing hooks and trace-id translation so Console traces map to tenant workloads, and (d) powers new dashboards and alerts (p50/p95/p99 latency, request error-rate, ingest queue depth) scoped by tenant/route/model.
acceptance_criteria: Relay accepts collector connections authenticated via mTLS with customer certs and rejects invalid certs
Per-tenant logical queues enforce soft quotas and backpressure; when quota exceeded, relay signals 429 with Retry-After and drops low-priority spans/logs per sampling policy
KV/trace id translation preserves trace continuity across relay (no duplicate trace ids) and is reversible for customer debugging
Console shows tenant-scoped latency and error dashboards with p50/p95/p99, throughput, and ingest queue depth for each Dedicated customer
End-to-end test in staging with synthetic tenant traffic simulating network partitions and bursty load; no cross-tenant data leakage observed
Runbook updated with steps for cert rotation, escalations for relay saturation, and rollback instructions
tasks: Design relay API and tenancy model (Jun + SRE) - spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Relay+Tenancy+Spec
Implement mTLS authentication and cert verification (ENG) - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/obs-relay/pull/214
Add bounded per-tenant queues with eviction tiers and persistent short-term on-disk buffer
Integrate trace-id translation hooks into runtime proxy to annotate spans with tenant_id and original_trace_id
Expose metrics (tenant.latency, tenant.errors, tenant.queue_depth) via metrics gateway and update metrics schema
Build Console dashboards and templated alerts (ops + PM review)
Create staging chaos test that simulates 100% packet loss to collector for 30s and validate replay behaviour
Security review and threat model (SST team) - schedule + remediation items
Rollout plan: canary deploy to staging-tenants -> 2 pilot customers on Dedicated -> wide rollout with feature flag
